create_glm_image_pipeline: create a GlmImagePipeline instance for text-to-image generation using the GLM-Image model
run_glm_image_generation: run the GlmImagePipeline __call__ method to generate images from text prompts with optional guidance scale
generate_prior_tokens: generate prior tokens for the DiT model using the autoregressive vision language encoder
encode_prompt: encode text prompts into glyph embeddings using the frozen T5 text encoder with optional classifier-free guidance
validate_and_normalize_images: validate and normalize image inputs to a consistent List[List[PIL.Image]] format for batch processing
